whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Desi Tadka Family Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 3.9★ reviews across 385+ ratings on Jamal Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile web page for table reservations and takeaway orders.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, popular food menu highlights, aur online ordering link integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/desitadka

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Desi Tadka Family Restaurant team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Desi Tadka Family Restaurant on Jamal Road) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table bookings and a rich food menu highlight for Fraser Road area foodies. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items, prices aur photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
